run_VAE_training: run the MNIST VAE training loop with sender and receiver networks for a specified number of epochs
create_Sender_network: create a Sender neural network module that encodes 784-dim MNIST images into mu and logvar latent variables
create_Receiver_network: create a Receiver neural network module that decodes latent messages back into 784-dim reconstructed MNIST images
build_VAE_Game: build a VAE_Game module combining Sender and Receiver with reparameterization trick and BCE plus KLD loss
review_ImageDumpCallback: review the ImageDumpCallback class that saves reconstructed MNIST images alongside originals at each epoch end
